description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'ActionBarShareActionProviderActivity' that demonstrates how to use ShareActionProvider for sharing images via the action bar. It includes methods for creating a share intent and copying a raw resource to a publicly accessible file.

classes.name: ActionBarShareActionProviderActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating the use of ShareActionProvider within the action bar to share images. It implements copying a raw resource to external storage and creates a share intent with the image URI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and calls a method to copy the resource to a publicly accessible file.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu, sets up ShareActionProvider instances for menu items, and assigns share intents.

methods.name: createShareIntent
methods.description: Creates and returns an intent for sharing an image file.

methods.name: copyPrivateRawResuorceToPubliclyAccessibleFile
methods.description: Copies a raw resource (R.raw.robot) into a file accessible to other apps for sharing.
